title: Office Ladies™
description:
Six inspirational HR managers. One mandatory training program.
Are you ready to get Safe For Work?ORGON® is proud to offer the world’s first Human Resources Training Program™ able to be enjoyed outside of the workplace. Enter the exciting world of HR consultancy and get close and personal with six confident women, driving deep institutional change as part of a fully consensual office simulation.

·       Solve Workplace Conflicts just like a real middle-aged woman!

·       Make meaningful choices that affect your story with ORGON® Zeroption™ technology!

·       Undertake a comprehensive Personalysis™!

·       Achieve a sense of pride and accomplishment as you unlock different subscriptions!

·       Find love!

Check your inbox. It’s time for your mandatory meeting. 

OFFICE LADIES™ is proud to offer an interactive Training Program™ that is entirely free from nudity or sexual content. All characters and events in this program, even those inadvertently resembling real people or groups, are entirely fictional. ORGON® cares about your privacy and only collects relevant data for quality and training purposes.
description_short: Get Safe for Work with six inspirational HR managers in this interactive Human Resources Training Program™
